authorization: PM: one readonly root round; record id before/on/off, restore UID 5001 on all exits. No board files, push, packages, configuration changes, attach, injection, kill or reboot.
transport: Exactly one persistent sdb shell for sampling. POSIX shell program is fed through stdin, never stored on board. Separate setup/restoration queries retain the 200-byte request limit; every stdin program line is also at most 200 UTF-8 bytes. Host sends one CONTINUE/END acknowledgement per completed batch in the same stdin stream. EOF prevents further batches. No reconnect or sampling rerun.
connectivity: sdb devices plus a short id query; on failure, one kill-server/start-server/connect sequence and one self-check retry, before root on. No second retry.
candidates: Reuse exactly the previous 11 candidates; confirm PID, comm, start_ticks. Before sampling rediscover restarted processes by unique exact comm, record changes; ambiguous/absent targets stop. Within sampling any identity change stops.

sampling.schedule: Board shell compares epoch seconds to preceding batch start + 1; sleep 1 only while before that deadline. No burst catch-up. Batch processing can overrun; all actual board and host timestamps are retained. Stop normally only after every target spans >=600 s on both board epoch and host monotonic clocks, and board shell elapsed seconds >=600. Count is measured, not padded to 601.
sampling.framing: Random nonce in SESSION/SAMPLE/READ/RC/END/FINAL markers. Each read has remote RC and DONE/FAIL; END commits only a complete batch. Host timestamps receipt of marker lines. Final remote RC=0 DONE and host transport exit 0 are both required.
sampling.health: 15 seconds with no received bytes, malformed/missing frame, process change, read failure or disconnect before FINAL => STOP. No automatic reconnect, no retry, no skip. Preserve complete batches and partial raw stream.
sampling.scope: Mapping headers and every Private_Dirty field are filtered by awk, then summed on host by unchanged analyze_floor.smaps. All heap/other-anon/file buckets preserved. stat read before and after smaps; globals read once per batch (meminfo, zram mm_stat, swaps). Sequential observations are not simultaneous; record read/batch spans.
sampling.tools: Probe cat/date/sleep/awk together before any sample; no timeout or sha256sum needed. Board epoch is read with date +%s (one-second resolution, represented as epoch_ns by appending nine zeros); precise interval/jitter comes from host monotonic receipt times, not fictional board nanosecond precision. No synthetic zeros for unavailable readings.

analysis.classifier: Unmodified audit_phenotypes.release_ratio_census, including dual tags and n/u outcomes. First current sample is current baseline; not a historical activity increment.
analysis.floor: Absolute minimum and first/last 60 actual board seconds minima; no live/bin or reclaimability inference.
analysis.confounding: Report positive zram steps, majflt, total PD and other-anon changes at largest drawdown. Global net swap flatness is not unique allocator attribution.
analysis.history: enlightenment +1736 KiB and ServiceA +788 KiB are activity increments; ServiceH 2360 KiB is an upper bound. Passive present absolute floors cannot be equated to those increments.

failure: Any gate failure stops observation and mandates root off plus UID 5001 proof if elevation attempted. An incomplete run yields STOP, not a 10-minute classification. Signed-file policy remains intact; stdin is PM-authorized, no script-signature bypass or file execution.
